title: 656. Find the Derangement of An Array

examples.explanation: One element cannot escape its own position.

hints: Let f[i] count derangements of i items with f[0] = 1 and f[1] = 0.
Placing item 1 into slot j (i-1 choices) splits on where item j goes, giving f[i] = (i-1) * (f[i-1] + f[i-2]).
Iterate bottom-up with two rolling values, reducing modulo 1000000007 each step.
